name: Realize MCP
description: Connect Claude to Taboola Realize to manage advertising end-to-end: campaign and creative creation, audience and geo targeting, reach estimation, and detailed performance reporting. Secured with OAuth 2.1; users authenticate via Taboola SSO and access only their own accounts.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Realize MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Realize MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.realize.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Realize MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Realize MCP lists 25 MCP tools, including create_campaign, create_display_item, create_native_item, get_campaign, get_campaign_breakdown_report, get_campaign_history_report, get_campaign_reach_estimate, get_campaign_site_day_breakdown_report, get_item, get_top_campaign_content_report, list_campaigns, and list_cta_types.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Realize MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Realize MCP in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Realize MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Realize MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Realize MCP is developed by Taboola. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
